gloss: to have more wins than losses; to take the lead

definitions.gloss: to have more wins than losses; to secure a winning record
definitions.explanation: To finish a series, season or sumo tournament with more wins than losses.

definitions.gloss: to take the lead (after a tie)
definitions.explanation: To go ahead again in a game after the score has been level.

examples.japanese: {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}した。
examples.english: He finished this tournament with a winning record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八勝目|はっしょうめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}した。
examples.english: The yokozuna took his eighth win and secured a winning record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{負|ま}け{越|こ}した→負け越す：32271_makekosu⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前半戦|ぜんはんせん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The team that had a losing record last year is already well above .500 in the first half of this season.

examples.japanese: {九回|きゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}した。
examples.english: They went ahead by a run in the ninth inning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}した。
examples.english: They scored in the second half and took the lead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同点|どうてん}→同点：08586_douten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}いつかれた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{再|ふたた}び→再び：03600_futatabi⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: They were pulled level, but went back ahead on the very next play.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In a fifteen-day sumo tournament, eight wins or more is a ⟦{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し→勝ち越し：21883_kachikoshi⟧ and usually means promotion in the rankings; seven or fewer is a {負|ま}け{越|こ}し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し→勝ち越し：21883_kachikoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to clinch a winning record
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し→勝ち越し：21883_kachikoshi⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: the go-ahead run or goal
- ⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}す: to go ahead by one point

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{負|ま}け{越|こ}す→負け越す：32271_makekosu⟧: to have more losses than wins, the opposite
- ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to come from behind and overtake; {勝|か}ち{越|こ}す is going ahead from a tie
